paragraphs.text: Kree is a creature type depicting a blue-skinned humanoid extraterrestrial species . It was introduced in Universes Beyond Marvel Super Heroes .

Kree is a Marvel Universes Beyond crossover type. They are a species of blue skinned humanoid aliens originally from the planet Hala though hold a large empire. They have often warred with the Skrull Empire. They created the Inhumans from genetic experiments on humans .
